title: Nova's Moon Mission
storyOpening: Mission lights blinked inside the training dome as Nova the Star floated beside a glowing map of the solar system. Today's launch window was open — but only if the crew completed every checklist.
missionPrompt: Help Nova prepare the rocket for a moon mission. Read the flight plan, pack supplies, and solve the math before countdown reaches zero!
readingPassage: In the training dome, Nova points to a poster of the Moon — a rocky world that orbits Earth. Astronauts travel in rockets because space has no air to breathe. Special suits carry oxygen and keep explorers safe. Your crew reads the supply list aloud: six food packets, four water pouches, and two antenna tools. Nova taps the countdown screen and says, "Every number must be right before we launch." Through the dome window, stars glitter like tiny campfires in the dark.
storyEnding: Liftoff! The rocket climbs above the clouds while Nova cheers. Your careful reading and counting made the moon mission possible.
reflectionPrompt: Which part of the flight plan helped you most, and why?
creativePrompt: Design a rocket with three special tools for exploring the Moon. Name each tool.
